4starredladybugofdoom.name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
4starredladybugofdoom.desc: FLIP: Destroy all Level 4 monsters your opponent controls.

azureoceandragonlordneodaedalusrage.name: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
azureoceandragonlordneodaedalusrage.desc:
4 monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 monsters that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your GY to your zones this card points to, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Monster Zone. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send all cards on the field to the GY, except "Umi".

belialmarquisofdarkness.name: Belial - Marquis of Darkness
belialmarquisofdarkness.desc: Your opponent cannot target any face-up monster you control, except "Belial - Marquis of Darkness", for an attack, or with Spell/Trap effects.

chimerathekingofphantombeasts.name: Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts
chimerathekingofphantombeasts.desc:
1 Beast monster + 1 Fiend monster
This card's name becomes "Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts" once per turn. If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can activate this effect; send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the GY during the End Phase of this turn. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Beast, Fiend, or Illusion monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

clockresonator.name: Clock Resonator
clockresonator.desc: Once per turn, this face-up Defense Position card cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

cloudianturbulence.name: Cloudian - Turbulence
cloudianturbulence.desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. When you Normal Summon this card, place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 1 Fog Counter from this card to Special Summon 1 "Cloudian - Smoke Ball" from your Deck or from either player's Graveyard.

fiendsmithsrequiem.name: Fiendsmith's Requiem
fiendsmithsrequiem.desc:
1 LIGHT Fiend monster
You can only Special Summon "Fiendsmith's Requiem(s)" once per turn. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Fiendsmith" monster from your hand or Deck. You can target 1 LIGHT non-Link Fiend monster you control; equip this card from your field or GY to that monster you control as an Equip Spell that gives it 600 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Fiendsmith's Requiem" once per turn.

galaxymirrorsage.name: Galaxy Mirror Sage
galaxymirrorsage.desc:
FLIP: You gain 500 LP for each "Galaxy" monster in your Graveyard.
When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard after being flipped face-up: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Galaxy" monster from your Deck or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. Banish it when it leaves the field.

generalraihooftheicebarrier.name: General Raiho of the Ice Barrier
generalraihooftheicebarrier.desc: When an effect resolves that was activated by an Effect Monster that was on your opponent's side of the field, they must discard 1 card or the effect is negated (their choice).

gladiatorlash.name: Gladiator Lash
gladiatorlash.desc: Activate only when you Special Summon a "Gladiator Beast" monster. Your opponent discards 1 card of their choice.

goukithemasterogre.name: Gouki The Master Ogre
goukithemasterogre.desc:
2+ "Gouki" monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can return to the hand any number of "Gouki" monsters you control that this card points to, then target the same number of face-up cards your opponent controls; they have their effects negated until the end of this turn. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If your opponent controls a face-up monster(s), this card can only target their monster with the highest ATK for attacks (your choice, if tied).

grappler.name: Grappler
grappler.desc: A devious snake with a thick body that wraps around an enemy monster and squeezes the life out of it.

grasschopper.name: Grasschopper
grasschopper.desc:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

helpingroboforunderwatercombat.name: Helping Robo for Underwater Combat
helpingroboforunderwatercombat.desc:
2 Machine monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it, also this card, then you can Special Summon 1 non-WATER Machine monster with 1600 or less ATK from your GY. If this card is banished: You can add 1 Machine monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helping Robo for Underwater Combat" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Machine monsters.

heraldryreborn.name: Heraldry Reborn
heraldryreborn.desc: Target 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

hieraticchant.name: Hieratic Chant
hieraticchant.desc: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Discard your entire hand (min. 1), add 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, you can Tribute Summon 1 monster during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.

ipiria.name: Ipiria
ipiria.desc: If this card is Summoned: Draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Ipiria" once per turn.

koakimeirushield.name: Koa'ki Meiru Shield
koakimeirushield.desc: Activate only when your opponent's monster declares an attack if you have 2 or more "Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru" in your Graveyard. Destroy all face-up Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

magicalundertaker.name: Magical Undertaker
magicalundertaker.desc: FLIP: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

myutantfusion.name: Myutant Fusion
myutantfusion.desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Myutant" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your hand or field. If your opponent has activated a card or effect this turn, you can use up to 1 monster each from your Deck and GY as Fusion Material. You can only activate 1 "Myutant Fusion" per turn.

photonstreamofdestruction.name: Photon Stream of Destruction
photonstreamofdestruction.desc: If you control a "Galaxy-Eyes" monster: Target 1 card on the field; banish that target. You can only activate this card during your turn, unless you control "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".

roadsynchron.name: Road Synchron
roadsynchron.desc: When using this card as Synchro Material for the Synchro Summon of a monster other than "Road Warrior", reduce this card's Level by 2. If this card attacks, at the end of the Damage Step: Increase its Level by 1 until the end of this turn.

spellbookofthegrandcircle.name: Spellbook of the Grand Circle
spellbookofthegrandcircle.desc: Add 4 "Charmer" monsters with different Attributes from your Deck, GY, and/or banishment to your hand, then shuffle 2 cards from your hand into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using "Charmer" or "Familiar-Possessed" monsters from your hand or field, also your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when a monster is Fusion Summoned this way. You can only use each effect of "Spellbook of the Grand Circle" once per turn.

thephantomknightsofrustybardiche.name: The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche
thephantomknightsofrustybardiche.desc:
2+ DARK monsters
During your Main Phase: You can send 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck to the GY, then Set 1 "Phantom Knights" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone. If a DARK Xyz Monster(s) is Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to, while this monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche" once per turn. Cannot be used as Link Material.

thundercrashsnarecrow.name: Thundercrash Snarecrow
thundercrashsnarecrow.desc: Each time a non-Thunder monster(s) is Special Summoned face-up, while this card is in the Monster Zone: That monster(s) cannot attack this turn, also destroy it during the End Phase. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 face-up card you control; destroy it, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Thundercrash Snarecrow" once per turn.
